## Invoice Editor

The line items of an invoice before it is sent, as an editing surface: add, remove and adjust rows, with each line's amount and a running total. It takes `@lineItems` and hands every change to `@onChange`, so the consumer decides when to save.

```gts
import InvoiceEditor from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/commerce/components/invoice-editor';

<InvoiceEditor @lineItems={{@model.lineItems}} @onChange={{this.setLineItems}} />
```

The total comes from `sumLineItems`, the same helper the Invoice card uses, so the editor and the sent invoice agree.

### Example

A draft with three lines (services by the hour, a fixed fee, training), wired to the example card's own `lineItems`.

### Non-goals

Doesn't save the invoice, apply tax or issue a number; those belong to the invoice and the command that issues it.
